main.Misgeret_Id: skip: framework identifier (one per row); row count is the framework count
main.Name: map-main — popup title only, and only for the allow-listed day/community frameworks; frameworks are aggregated everywhere else
main.Type_Descr: chart-types, chart-tree, chart-box, chart-net, map-main, kpi:types, insight:type — mirrored parentheses in the source fixed for display; the map uses a positive allow-list of day/community types
main.Head_Department: chart-dept, chart-tree, chart-owner, chart-heat, chart-years, chart-gender, map-main, insight:dept, insight:region, insight:capacity — the map excludes departments that serve protected populations (women and girls, youth protection and rehabilitation, addiction, probation)
main.Second_Classific: map-main — 85% 'לא משויך'; used only to keep sensitive sub-classifications (sexual abuse, detention alternative, behaviour problems) off the map
main.Organization: chart-net, insight:networks — national networks/NGOs; the leading code number is stripped for display; '0 ללא ארגון' = none
main.ORGANIZATIONS_BUSINES_NUM: skip: registration number of the network in Organization (1:1); the page names the network instead
main.Registered_Business_Id: kpi:operators — counted only; never shown (for private operators it can be a personal ID number)
main.Actual_Capacity: chart-dept, chart-types, chart-region, chart-auth, chart-box, kpi:capacity, kpi:median_cap, kpi:unreported, insight:capacity, insight:unreported — 0 treated as not reported
main.Gender_Descr: chart-gender — 94% 'לא ידוע'; only gender-specific frameworks are charted
main.Status_des: skip: constant ('פעילה' — the file lists active frameworks only); stated in the lede
main.STARTD: chart-years, insight:recent — start date of frameworks active today (survivor view, disclosed); latest partial year labelled
main.Maneger_Name: skip: manager's personal name; adds nothing to an aggregate page
main.City_Name: map-main — popup only; the page aggregates by welfare authority (Authoritys), which this mostly duplicates
main.Adrees: skip: street address; never on the page (protected facilities) — map points come from coordinates of allow-listed frameworks only
main.Telephone: skip: contact number, often a private mobile
